steps.name: A Certain Memory
steps.objective: Check what happened in front of [Minuet], then find [Atkina] in the "Dragon Valley".

lines.text: (Following a wind from somewhere far away, the adventurer arrives in Adrica. Minuet stands ahead with a vacant expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Are you all right?
(No matter how often the adventurer calls, Minuet gives no answer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Did something happen? Hey...
(The adventurer's vision suddenly fills with black.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?! This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just like that time...)
Urgh, aaaaaagh!
(Cries of pain echo through an unfamiliar place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...

choices.text: 1. Who is that? Whose voice is it?

lines.text: It hurts... It hurts...
(The suffering figure slowly becomes visible in the darkness.)
Urgh...
Hah... hah...
▒▒... I have to find it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Black horns on his head. Could he be a demon?)
The magic stones those humans have aren't enough!
Urgh... hah... hah...
Who's there? Who's watching me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can that demon not see me? Why can I see him?
I'm getting oversensitive...
I have to fill it...
Otherwise...
Aaaaaagh...
Magic stones... A ▒▒ made from magic stones... I have to find it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Those are...
(Black and blue magic stones lie piled before the black-horned boy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones made by the Deimos cult...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are those stones there?
(The adventurer's vision blurs again, and the demon can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Open your eyes now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Oh, I'm still Minuet. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that you, Lady Gaia?
(A sacred light begins to rise around Minuet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Just like before, when she turned into Lady Gaia...)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Once more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Ah, I think it will work now...
(The sacred light rises again, and Minuet takes the form of the goddess Gaia.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It has been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It seems I am long overdue for sleep, yet I still cannot rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know what I just saw?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Did you see something just now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer describes seeing a demon boy in the darkness with a great many magic stones from the Deimos cult.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It sounds as though you saw a region of the Demon Realm... Perhaps that was the relic's influence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The relic... You mean...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The Flame of Truth that Lethe possessed...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Perhaps Lethe wanted to tell you something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lethe... Has she ceased to exist?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You may meet her again when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose that's a relief... I had so much I wanted to ask her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Lady Gaia. Could you tell me now why you called for me?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The Champions' power that you and Iris need... Three remain now. A trace of one... You will find it by traveling north beyond Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: At my request, Atkina and Medea have unsealed the path they closed. You may travel through it now.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Before you go, speak with Atkina. He will tell you something that should help.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I will be going, then. Until we meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.
(Sacred light passes over Gaia, revealing Minuet once more.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes... Oh, I felt sleepy for a moment...

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Lady Gaia told me to sleep whenever I could... I'll take a little nap.
(No sooner has Minuet spoken than she falls asleep standing up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She looks so peaceful... It's enough to make me want a nap, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Then I'll go see Lord Atkina. I should find out what's happening there.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I've been waiting, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lady Gaia said you would tell me about someone who could help me, so I came to see you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, did she? Lady Gaia...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Very well. I'll explain.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Recently, many demons appeared in Phobos. Nothing serious happened, but I set up a simple barrier to protect the settlements and spirit beasts.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Medea helped me as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Demons...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He knows Phobos well, so I told him in advance that the goddess's messenger would be arriving soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: His name is Veled. He should be fighting the demons and monsters in Phobos. Speak with him and find what needs doing, and you should be able to meet the Fierce King as well.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Valdrick always appears in Phobos around this time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I would like to help you myself, but there is work I must attend to in Adrica. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll head to Phobos, then.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Please, don't judge Veled harshly when you see him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does he mean, don't judge him harshly? I'll think about it later. For now, to Phobos.)
(As %s leaves Dragon Valley, a breeze carrying flower petals blows in from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Lady Gaia...
(Gaia appears where the warm breeze has passed.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry, Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Forgive me, Lady Gaia. What happened last time...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: It wasn't your fault, Atkina. Don't trouble yourself over it. The fault lies with those who invaded this place.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Are you all right, Lady Gaia? And Lady Iris...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry you had to endure something you never wanted.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm all right. I was only worried about you... Ah...
(Gaia approaches Atkina and rests her face against his chest.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Everything will be all right.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes, Lady Gaia.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Just as Seres did, I too will act for this land...

steps.name: Testing Your Skills
steps.objective: Defeat [Oblivious Curirings] and [Gominam] in "Phobos", then report to [Veled].

lines.text: You lot never get tired of this, do you? I suppose that's what happens when you can't learn.
(A youthful-looking boy grins and reaches toward the charging demons and monsters. Red light streams from his hand and envelops them.)
Sort yourselves out.
(The demons' and monsters' eyes change, and they begin attacking each other.)
I know you're there. Stop watching and come out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you spotted me.
I know they came at me because you showed up. Creatures ruled by instinct always react to power. And I don't mean ordinary power. Special power...
Come to think of it, are you the person old Atkina sent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Then you're Veled...?
(The boy called Veled grins and offers a handshake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nice to meet you. I'm %s...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm Veled. I've heard about you. The old fellow asked me to help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I can feel a strange power through his fingertips...)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You really are different from ordinary humans. Most just come to me in a trance...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm a demon, but I'm not interested in anything else, so don't worry. There's only one thing I care about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought something was different about you, but a demon...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm not an ordinary demon. I'd appreciate it if you didn't compare me to those idiots.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: So, where do we start?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I do want to help you, but I don't even know what you can do. So...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You'll have to give me a clear demonstration. Take down those idiots over there. With your power, that shouldn't be a problem, right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Every one we get rid of will help Peonia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But who's Peonia?)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll wait here. Go on, then.

steps.name: The Red Land's Problem Solver
steps.objective: Defeat [Searching Trackers] and [Elegant Noble Succubi] in "Phobos", then find [Crisien] in "Mars".

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You're the first human like this I've met since coming here. I've seen fixers who claimed to be the best, but...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Taking down this many demons and monsters... You really do deserve the name Executioner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then let me explain. It's nothing complicated. Lots of demons are appearing in Phobos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can see that for myself...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The trouble is, I don't know exactly where they're coming from. We need to find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You don't trust me, do you? That's fine. It's only natural. To humans, demons and other strange beings are all suspicious.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: But could you trust me anyway? I like humans. As one being with a mind and a soul to another, beyond being a demon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I get the feeling there's someone in particular, beyond humans in general...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. Peonia. The person I love. You're going to Mars anyway, so you'll meet her soon enough.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Sigh... After all this, I wish Peonia would just trust me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...
(There is something sad in Veled's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I keep hunting these stupid demons for Peonia. It would be nice if a solution turned up along the way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: That old fellow is unusual. After I was banished, he rescued me when I collapsed on the border between Phobos and Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Banished?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The truth is, I was so popular in Rosengarten that the other dream demons drove me out. Just look at this beauty!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd say you're more cute than beautiful... Oh! Sorry.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What? You don't think I'm beautiful?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Whew. First Peonia, now you. You both need an eye that can properly distinguish cuteness from beauty.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Let me explain beauty to you. Oh, no. Peonia said not to force things on people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for telling me. I'll ask Peonia, then.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hey, you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Thanks for listening. And sorry. I haven't really helped you at all...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about it. It's fine.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia listens, but she's still wary. Strong-willed humans try to kill me. Foolish ones fall under my charm and die...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This looks complicated...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've just been through all kinds of things.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Right. You're definitely no ordinary person...
Hey, you two. Sorry to interrupt...
(The adventurer turns toward the voice and sees a rough-looking man.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A fixer?

lines.speaker: 해결사
lines.text: That's right. A red-haired woman called Peonia told me to ask the red-horned demon here. Said you'd know.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, the target should be deeper in, over that way.

lines.speaker: 해결사
lines.text: Right. Thanks.
(The man called a fixer leaves as soon as he gets his answer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who was that?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: A fixer hired by Mars. There are more monsters and demons than we expected, so they told them to ask me here.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: About half of them either shake with fear or throw themselves into my arms. That one was a little different.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Anyway, head to Mars. Give Crisien and Peonia my regards. You'll find Crisien as soon as you enter town.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: And take care of any demons or monsters that get in your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Phobos really is strange... Even that fixer didn't find anything odd about Veled...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I don't know. Lady Gaia sent me here for a reason, so I'll visit this Peonia first. I'm bound to learn something.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hmm. Is it my imagination? Why do these strange thoughts keep coming...? I... And that fixer bothers me, too...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah, forget it.
Ugh, I'm sleepy... I should have gone to bed early. There's so much work...
(A sleepy-eyed, red-haired girl yawns on a bench. Holding a needle, thread, and cloth, she tries to work, only to nod off again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. Are you Crisien?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yes, I'm Crisien.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled asked me to give his regards to you and Peonia.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Really? Veled did? The mayor won't let him into Mars, so he must have asked someone passing by.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello? Why did you stop in the middle of...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ah! Sorry... I nodded off for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You aren't ill, are you? I saw a doctor over there.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Yaaawn. Sorry. It's nothing that serious. I need to mend Veled's clothes sometime, too... Hmm, but things aren't good enough for that yet...

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Pio has so much work, too... But I haven't seen you before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I came from another region on business.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Are you a fixer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Wow, I see. Come back later and I'll mend your clothes. I'll make you some nice ones, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's nodding off again.)

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: I'm not! I was just thinking about where Pio might be! Keep going this way and you'll find her.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: You have a nice face for a fixer. Most people who come here look so scary. That man who passed by earlier frightened me, too.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Ugh, and it's noisy when Uncle Valdrick visits... The mayor's away, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did the mayor go?

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: The mayor's really wonderful, but we haven't seen him lately. Maybe he's away on business. It's been quite a while... That's why Pio is so busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, is that so? Thank you, Crisien.

lines.speaker: 크리시엔
lines.text: Mm-hmm...
(Crisien nods off again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I'd better not wake her. She looks exhausted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, but Valdrick? It seems the Fierce King really is nearby...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask Peonia first. It feels like I'll meet him soon, but I still don't know...
(In front of a building deeper along the streets of Mars, a red-haired woman explains something to a group.)
(The burly men nod in understanding and head toward Phobos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are those people fixers...?
You're a fixer, right? Welcome. This is Mars City. I'm Peonia, Mayor Klaus's secretary and steward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, um...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: People elsewhere call it Phobos, but Phobos is the name of this entire region.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Call it Phobos or Mars, either is fine. It's the land everyone here loves, regardless.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Your job is to defeat the monsters and demons in Phobos. You'll be paid according to how many you take down.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: You don't need to keep count. A special being in Phobos will do that. Report to me when you want to quit or when your term ends.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'll pay you according to your total. Write your name here and sign.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. Could you listen for a moment?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Sign first. I don't have time to talk, so please understand. Some fixers have left, which means the pay is pretty good. If you work hard, you can...
(Peonia tilts her head at the name %s on the signed document.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: %s...? I've heard that name somewhere.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, Rosemary told me. You're a hero.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. I'm no hero... But Rosemary is here?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: She said she went all the way to Avalon to hunt down a Demigod she didn't like, then fled. She crossed the mountains from Lumen, apparently.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'd love to follow her example. I wish Mars had a few more people like her.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Pretend you didn't hear that. So what brings our hero here? Come to meet a Champion or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing special.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: A hero arrives, and it's nothing special? An obvious lie, but I'll let it slide. What would you like to hear about? Old Valdrick?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The mayor...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'll tell you about old Valdrick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Did she change the subject?)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Valdrick, the man so obsessed with fighting that he became a Champion, called the Fierce King because of his scars... Whenever he shows up, all of Phobos becomes a racket.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Hunting monsters is fine. But whenever he comes into Mars, he leaves one or two alive, and those survivors always gather a whole pack and come after him.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Still, I know he isn't a bad person. He's helped me, Mars City, and the mayor. He saved us from the Deimos cult's attack, shouting, 'Weiss, you bastard!'

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: There are all kinds of rumors, but please don't believe them until you've met him yourself. People believe things they've never experienced. They do it to Veled, too.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled isn't bad. Still, he's a demon, so people have to be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Veled...)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Somehow I've ended up talking about Veled. If you need to go out into Phobos, he'll help you.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: He's a sweet boy who truly likes humans. Oh! What am I saying...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Oh, look at the time! Sorry, hero. I'm busy. There's a lot I have to do.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: So... if you want to know anything else, you'll have to ask someone else. An outsider's view should be more accurate than mine, at least.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.
(As soon as she finishes speaking, Peonia heads off with the people who came to see her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place has its own share of problems... Shall I go say hello to Rosemary?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: ...I wanted to rest, and now I have to see a familiar face.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I leave?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Forget it. Come here. Keep me company for a bit. I was bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. How long have you been in Mars City?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: A while. Somehow I ended up going into Avalon, then getting chased out. I thought I'd rest here...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'd like to return to Freios, but it hasn't worked out. You look curious. What do you want to know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I tried asking Peonia about the mayor, she seemed to change the subject.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Really? I don't know the details either, but I'll tell you what I know.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You know the Fierce King? Not because he's vicious; the man who became a Champion through his obsession with combat. They say he visits Phobos every year.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Mayor Klaus thought it would be good to befriend a Champion, so they sparred. Valdrick got excited and went wild. He was having a great time, but the mayor must have felt like he was dying.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then, when the time for Valdrick's visit came around, Mayor Klaus disappeared.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: And a large number of demons appeared in Phobos. More monsters, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Shall we put that together?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Valdrick arrives, the mayor disappears, and demons and monsters show up eyeing this land. Surely that isn't all coincidence?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What about Veled?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Veled?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That demon Veled is unusual, but the timing doesn't match the mayor's disappearance. He came here much earlier.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: He fell for Peonia at first sight and courted her for ages, but she flatly rejected him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: When they told him he couldn't enter the city because he frightened the residents, he just stayed outside looking this way. Said he'd keep waiting...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: A demon who's a hopeless romantic... And an incubus, at that. Normally I'd have destroyed him already, but Peonia stopped me.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Still, he's odd. He destroys other demons, his own kind, and seems to do whatever the mayor tells him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I find Valdrick, could I learn something about the mayor?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Who knows? Are you going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mm-hmm...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Do what you like. Peonia said she wanted to clear up the misunderstanding about Valdrick, so you might as well do that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both Crisien and Peonia seem to think well of him.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Apparently Valdrick stays in a place called the Cradle every year. Try there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: And I was going to deliver a message from Peonia to Veled, but I can't be bothered. You do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What message?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Nothing much. Just say thank you. She said he'd understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll see Veled before going to the Cradle. What will you do now, Rosemary?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Me? Get back to work, I suppose. I'm only here for a little while...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'll contact you separately if I meet any Demigods.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Ugh, what a nuisance. Why do I have to clean up after those people...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Demigods...)
I have found you, my doll.
(The image of a boy appears before Veled and reaches out. It is only an image, and its hand cannot touch him. Still, its voice continues to address Veled.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Who are you? An incubus?
We shall meet soon, my doll. Very soon...
(The figure before Veled vanishes without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: He's gone.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Why would a demon I've never met call me a doll? A beautiful sculpture, perhaps, but a doll...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, what are you doing?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Doll or sculpture, why would someone so beautiful as me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You're back? Nothing much. Oh, let me ask you something. Do I look like a sculpture or a doll?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean, a sculpture or a doll?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Someone called me a doll. No beautiful doll in the world could compare to me... What was that about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Anyway, what brings you here? Want a lecture on beauty?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll pass on the lecture. I'm here with a message from Peonia.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Huh?
(Veled's bored eyes sparkle at the mention of Peonia.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What? Say that again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to deliver a message from Peonia.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What did Peonia say?! Quickly, tell me! Let me hear it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Now this is actually frightening...)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Come on, come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Nothing else, just thank you. She said you'd understand.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Peonia! Thank you too!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He really is an unusual demon.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s, thank you for bringing Peonia's message. I'd like to do something for you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. W-wait...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Do you feel that energy...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. That's definitely...
(Before the adventurer can finish, darkness mingled with an unknown, ominous energy sweeps into Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What a nuisance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, do you know what's happening?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Some powerful demon is openly announcing its presence. Maybe it's after something...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ugh...
(Veled suddenly clutches his chest and sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I think so. What's wrong with me...? I'm suddenly afraid... This has never happened before...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Not even when a legion commander-level demon appeared. What on earth...? Ah...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (His expression changed for a moment. As though he remembered something...)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You go on ahead. I need some rest. I'm suddenly tired.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. All right.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Clear up the misunderstanding about that human Valdrick, too. Peonia wants that, so you're better suited to it than a demon like me.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: The Cradle where he stays is over that way. And be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You'll understand when you get there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, anyway. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But what am I supposed to be careful of? And what will I understand when I get there...?)

steps.name: The Master's Cradle
steps.objective: Defeat [Lilith] in the "Cradle of Illusions", then report to [Valdrick] in "Phobos".

lines.text: (Just as %s approaches what seems to be the Cradle of Illusions, an immense force comes flying from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?! It's unbelievably fast...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I couldn't sense it. What is this power...? If that had hit me, I would definitely have died...)
It was you, just as I thought.
(As the dust clears, a huge red-haired man stands before the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're Valdrick, right? The Fierce King...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's right, I'm Valdrick! Ahahaha! Good to meet you! I've heard about you. Or rather, I came to know about you. Either way, good to meet you! Ahahaha!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't like formality. Just speak freely.
(Valdrick grins and offers his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Valdrick. It's good to meet you too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What an incredible grip. He barely squeezed, but I can feel tremendous strength.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: An ordinary person would have felt my power and run. You held up well!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I've never seen you before, but somehow it's good to see you. You have some idea why, right? We keep learning things we'd rather not know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I can't be bothered, so I let them go as soon as they come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds like a good approach. I came to find you, and here you are.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Peonia's worried about you. She says the residents have the wrong idea.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: She's always like that. I tell her to stop nagging, but she keeps at it. And she's always so busy she never rests.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Recently, she even picked up a troublesome demon. I was going to teach him a lesson, but she told me not to touch him. She really puts everything into life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing here, anyway?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You know Klaus disappeared, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some people think you might have done something to him. I came to clear up the misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Heh, really? I can see why people who fear me might think that. I'm used to misunderstandings... I'm looking for Klaus myself. I'm sure he's nearby, but I can't find him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He really doesn't care.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Anyway, you felt it too, right? The power of some crazy demon lingering around here... It's probably what's leading all the demons gathering in Phobos.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So, come to the Cradle with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Cradle...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The village where my master's remains were kept. Though it's only ruins now... Can you feel that demon's power ahead?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't know why, but I think there's a strong one in there! And I think we'll find Klaus!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Valdrick looks delighted...)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, you understand, right? This is what power is for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Power...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Great! Straight to the Cradle of Illusions!
(Before the words have faded, Valdrick dashes into the Cradle of Illusions. He is far too fast to catch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said we'd go together... Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's get going.
(Deep in the Cradle of Illusions, Valdrick gleefully parries the attacks of a grotesque being.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Wow, you're really strong! Different from the demons I've met before! Now this is fun!
A vulgar human obsessed with fighting...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You think I'll rise to that provocation? Hahaha, then I'll live up to your expectations. How would Master have taken you down?
A musclehead, but blessed by a god, so I can't read his thoughts! My charm doesn't work either! This is infuriating!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a powerful scent of roses...
'That'? To a noble, beautiful dream demon...? Ah, you! You're that human. You won't leave this place. I'll destroy you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? You sound as though you know me.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I am Lilith. I will drive thorns into your chest and make roses grow there. You killed my love, and I will pass judg—

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Too much chatter during a fight. Hah!
(Valdrick's powerful attack fills the space with an enormous vortex.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What took you so long?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Valdrick. You took a shortcut on your own, while I, who didn't know the way, had to deal with every monster and demon!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hahaha, sorry, sorry. I'll buy you a meal later. Priring curry sound good? Hey, you! Watch out!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?
(Something flashes through the thick dust. In an instant, Valdrick rushes in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: V-Valdrick!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick!

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I thought you were only a battle-crazed human. So you have some compassion after all?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: We Champions feel a kind of inner friendship with this one. Like we're close even when meeting for the first time.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You... For a supposedly noble demon, you fight dirty. Afraid one wouldn't kill, so you threw dozens disguised as one...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This hurts quite a bit. First time since that bastard Weiss got me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick, are you all right? That wound...
(An enormous thorn is embedded in Valdrick's abdomen.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Of course I'm not all right. Unlike the little one, I can die, but I'm not going to. Don't panic. Just deal with this quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. But by the little one, do you mean...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Spend that time landing another blow on that dream demon. I'll patch myself up. Just wait. Hah!
(Valdrick shouts, and the thorn lodged in his abdomen falls out. Blood continues to pour from the wound.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Stupid human... Bragging when you look ready to die at any moment... Well, never mind.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Lord Degos. The time has come. I will kill the human who made you disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Degos...?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: The incarnation of rage whom I loved. He was so beautiful. I fell for that beauty and abandoned even Asmodea to follow him, and you killed him.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: A world without his beauty was unbearable. And Asmodea did this to my body because I wouldn't follow him.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: He told me to take the form of the man I loved! Turning my beautiful self into this monster...

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Beloved by so many dream demons, yet jealous because I wouldn't love him... Well, I am beautiful.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: As soon as the gate opened, I came through Rosengarten to find you. If I defeat you, Asmodea will acknowledge me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She's mistaken. Degos wasn't destroyed. He clearly said he'd return. Hasn't she heard?)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: You must see my beauty properly. Only then will Lord Degos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whether she's mistaken doesn't matter. She's an enemy standing in my way...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lilith. If you were on Degos's side, you must know what sort of person I am.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good. I'll do to you what I've done to everyone who tried to harm living beings.
(At those words, darkness fills Lilith's burning red eyes.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I look forward to it. At least I won't end up like Lord Degos!

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: I... I can't defeat this human... Lord Degos...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll grant that you're as strong as Degos.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: He... He...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But to me, you and Degos are just the same: demons who threaten this world.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Don't think we're the same! I am a pure demon. He was a human who became a demon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You claim you loved Degos, yet you draw distinctions over his origins and hope not to share his fate. A demon full of contradictions, talking about love...

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: That's... That's...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was all that talk of love nonsense?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: My love isn't a lie. No, more than that, there's something strange about you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's strange about me? Answer my question.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is the love dream demons speak of real? Or do your own abilities make you mistake it for love?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (One strike would finish this. Why am I hesitating?)
(Lilith's expression changes as she realizes something. She looks less like a beautiful dream demon than a monster from the deepest pit of hell.)
(But only for a moment. An immense, searing force flies toward Lilith from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Valdrick...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That's right. Valdrick, the Fierce King.
(Valdrick approaches with a bright expression and pats %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Why are you hesitating?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Oh, I see. Then leave the finishing blow to me. This suits me better than you.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What was your name, anyway? Come to think of it, I never asked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's... %s.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Right, %s.
(Valdrick smiles upon hearing %s's name. At that smile, Lilith seems to sense something and begins to tremble.)

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: S-spare me...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You, Lili? Lilith? Ah, who cares. You, demon. Answer my question properly, and I'll think about it.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Y-yes, anything...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Have you seen Klaus? A man about my height, with a strikingly handsome smile. Early to mid-forties, blond hair, blue eyes.

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: Th-that man. He went th-there. R-Rosengarten...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Where's that?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: The D-Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: The Demon Realm? How does a human go there?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: W-well, Rosengarten has connected to somewhere in Phobos. I don't know any more. I don't! Is that enough? P-please spare me...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s, I have some business with this demon. Wait a moment. Close your eyes for a bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's such madness coming from Valdrick... I'd better do as he says.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mm-hmm...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: %s... Good kid. You, Lili-whatever... Ah, just demon. Do you know why people call me the Fierce King?

lines.speaker: 릴리스
lines.text: H-how would I know some insignificant human's title?!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: A noble demon would have no interest in an insignificant human. Of course you wouldn't know.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then I'll teach you. I am the one who makes even demons tremble...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Because I am the king of all the world's savagery!
(As Valdrick's crazed voice falls silent, immense power races past both sides of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lilith's gone. No, she's been annihilated. She didn't even scream... It looked like Valdrick only gathered his power and struck once...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough, cough. Ugh, the dust...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where has Valdrick gone now?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Here.
(Covered in dust, Valdrick leaps out from somewhere and lands before %s.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Let's get out first. We'll talk outside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: ...That was less of a rampage than you might think.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Less than I might think?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This is my master's hometown, so I held back. I've been restoring it whenever I have time. Don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I've got plenty of time, as long as I don't die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What was your master like?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: A good person. It's been so long now. She helped the weak until the very end. Then she died.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I wanted revenge, but Master wouldn't have wanted it. Whoever killed her probably grew old and died on their own.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What hurts is that I wasn't there at the end. By the time I heard she was dead and returned, only a memorial tablet remained in the shrine. They said her ashes had been scattered somewhere in Debora overlooking the sea...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: If you meet anyone from a country called Jin, ask them. They'll tell you what a female martial artist named Hwan means to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. From the name alone, I thought your master was a man.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Right? I thought so at first, too. Ah, enough about Master.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You heard that Klaus went to a place called Rosengarten, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. It's connected to somewhere in Phobos...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Where could that be?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't we ask someone?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll have to look for it.
(Before the adventurer can respond, Valdrick races off into Phobos, far too fast to follow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... Valdrick...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was going to suggest asking Veled. He said he was from Rosengarten...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He really doesn't listen to other people. Nothing for it. I'll have to go alone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But I was like that again. A version of me that doesn't feel like me... Valdrick noticed. Even the demon did.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But... this energy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel a strange energy from where Veled was...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. I don't know. Let's see Veled first.

steps.name: An Alluring Rose
steps.objective: Defeat [Asmodea] in "Rosengarten" and obtain the <Red Rose Pendant>. Then report to [Veled] in "Phobos".

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: %s, don't come closer...
(Veled covers one eye, his face contorted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Stop...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is demonic power. Like when I met Degos and Malphas... But I didn't feel it at first.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't help being like this right now. So stay away! I'm b-barely holding on!

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: This isn't what I wanted...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Go to Rosengarten, quickly! Once you go there, I can hold on a little longer. I have to!
(As Veled cries out, blood begins to run from his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: R-Rosengarten is connected to an old well the people of Phobos used. There are rose vines and fallen petals, so y-you'll find it easily...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Go and bring me the ornament that belongs on this necklace. Otherwise... I might kill Peonia with my own hands...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I am me. He says he's my master... But I... I...
(Before Veled can finish, his body begins to stiffen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled...
Perhaps I should have left him alone. Let him bring me the souls of the humans here... He'll return eventually anyway...
(A voice resembling Veled's comes from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's definitely... the voice of the one I saw before coming to Phobos...)
(The speaker's form becomes faintly visible.)
What a noisy doll. There was no need to explain things to a mere human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're definitely...
So that human can see me. Were you the one watching me then? Daring to peer into the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
What an ill-mannered human. Courtesy demands that you introduce yourself first. No matter. I already know.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I am Asmodea, master of Rosengarten and ruler of the dream demons. If you met Lilith, you must know my name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Asmodea.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: It was wise to place Lilith where someone powerful was nearby. She let me see how much strength you possess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Lilith wasn't there of her own free will.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: She was a dream demon, after all. She merely fell under the charm of her ruler. Naturally, she believed she went of her own accord.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: An ordinary human would already be under my charm, coming to offer their soul. Yet you are unaffected... Fascinating. Enough to stir even my heart...
(Asmodea smiles and extends a hand. A single rose blooms at his fingertips.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I formally invite you to Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That rich scent of roses... It's coming from that way...)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Come to me. And offer me your soul.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And if I refuse?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You will have no choice.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: If you do not come, even more demons and monsters will march into Phobos.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You would not want that, would you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spoken like a demon...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I take that as a compliment. The Demon Realm's way of thinking differs from yours.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I shall wait, with anticipation. Finding a fine soul with great power is a stroke of fortune even for a demon.
(Asmodea smiles again, and the rose in his hand turns to ash. A breeze scatters it, and his form disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An elaborate way to issue an invitation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...At a time like this, a prophecy from the Empress of Silvaria saying I'd resolve everything would be reassuring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go, then...
(Bright light spills through the dark space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is Rosengarten...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's so beautiful it hardly seems real. A garden full of roses in lovely sunlight...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Like a noble's estate...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So this is the Demon Realm. Just getting here, little sibling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whoa, you startled me! Valdrick, when did you arrive?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Just now. I finally found it. What a strong scent of roses...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But... little sibling?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: We've faced life and death together. That makes us family already. I call everyone my little sibling, regardless of gender.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I get the feeling you'd keep calling me that even if I asked you not to.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Little sibling Ziskad gave up, too. Though he made up for it by drinking a tremendous amount...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you forget my name?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Ahahaha! Don't worry about things like that, little sibling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He definitely forgot. Oh, that's bothering me...)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: So, little sibling. Tell me what's going on. It seems you came here for more than Klaus...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Valdrick what happened to Veled.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I see. Things have gotten complicated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will you do, Valdrick? The path splits in two...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: You had the same thought, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mm-hmm...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll go left, you go right. Oh, if you find Klaus, stay with him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I don't know what Mayor Klaus looks like.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Red hair, blue eyes, about my height, and handsome. When there's trouble, he wears armor with gold chains. You'll recognize him easily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll look for him along the way.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good luck, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You too, Valdrick. Huh? You used my name. And he's already gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Then let's begin.
(At a dead end in the rose garden, Asmodea sits before an elegant table.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Wait a moment. Tea has just begun. Let me enjoy it a little before we speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You invite a guest, then keep them waiting.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Oh, a guest? Did I invite you? Then I shall gladly pour you a cup as well.
(Asmodea fills an empty teacup and offers it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who knows what's in that tea...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Roses rooted in the remnants of souls, nourished by them... Their first petals are touched by the hands of a beautiful succubus.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Drink tea brewed from those petals, and you will wish to remain in Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A prized specialty that even other demons long to taste.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to know.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Then sit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard Mayor Klaus came here.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Klaus? Was that his name? I have no need to remember human names, but it sounds familiar.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is he now?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Quite a fine soul, though better suited to be swallowed by a greedy demonic beast like Einhorn than by me.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: If you still want an answer, go and speak to Einhorn. Perhaps the man's voice will emerge from the beast's mouth...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Perhaps your brother has already destroyed it...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Greed grows vast and endless. That human mayor was no exception. That is why he set foot in Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: He seems to have struck a fine bargain with Weiss's messenger. To have his wish granted, he offered generous terms. Every living being in Phobos and Mars...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weiss again... And why would Mayor Klaus...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Klaus? That was the sort of man he was. Worth less than the Deimos cult's magic stones, packed with the power of living beings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to do with those stones? Why do you want a doll made from magic stones?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You clearly called Veled a doll.
(Asmodea's expression darkens. His smile and easy composure vanish.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: So you heard that much.
(The bright light of Rosengarten dims, and a demonlike being appears above Asmodea.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Long ago, there was a Twisted One whom certain beings followed. Phobos, it was called. This is a part of him. My friend, a demon god, will fight you beside me.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Enough needless explanations, human...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Together with my doll, become the nourishment that fills my emptiness. Messenger of the goddess... Hehehe.
(After a brief silence, blood begins to trickle from Asmodea's mouth.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Impossible... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: The demon god Phobos, destroyed... Even if it was only a fragment, Phobos is Deimos's twin...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Cough, cough.
(Asmodea coughs up blood and collapses.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From your talk of emptiness and power, your soul must have been incomplete. You meant to fill it with the doll and me...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Cough, cough... I will not deny it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer one question.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: About Weiss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: There is little to tell... Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I merely agreed to answer his summons.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Were magic stones the price for summoning demons?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon who wants magic stones made by gathering life force...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah! Is that it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something went wrong with your power. So you have to replenish it another way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look as though you hate to admit it.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: In the Demon Realm, a weak demon is immediately devoured. To survive...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You had no choice if you wanted to survive, so you made a deal?

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I cannot fall here. I will fill my emptiness, reach beyond Rosengarten to Pandemonium... And that bastard Degos, and Lux...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Yes... Urgh, aaaaaagh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!
(Rosengarten shakes at Asmodea's desperate struggle. An opening forms, offering glimpses of Phobos and Mars City.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Rosengarten! You may surrender your beauty! Devour Phobos! Swallow every soul in Phobos and bring them to me!
(At Asmodea's words, the roses of Rosengarten suddenly wither, then rot and release a strange odor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-this is...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I cannot bear for Rosengarten to lose its beauty, but if only it will fill my emptiness!

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Ugh... M-my body... You, a doll made from my power and magic stones, dare...

lines.speaker: 벨레드의 목소리
lines.text: (Asmodea. If you can destroy me, that means I can do the same to you...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled? His voice seems to be echoing all over Rosengarten. What's happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Asmodea's body is freezing...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Weiss, I will never forgive you...
(Flames suddenly rise from the fingertips of Asmodea, whose entire body has stiffened.)
(A moment later, the beautiful demon turns to ash and scatters on the wind. A single rose-shaped pendant drops beneath him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this what Veled wanted? Then everything here is finished, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew... First, I should find Valdrick... Huh?
I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are...?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You may know me. I'm Baral, who served under the old man. The Spirit King's medicine works well, I see. Judging by how stupidly you stood there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral? Urgh... When did you attack...?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I attacked four times, and you didn't notice a single one.
(As he finishes speaking, the hook wound around Baral's hand flies toward %s. An enormous shock wave easily knocks it away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Valdrick...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Rest for a bit, little sibling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh. Just a word from Valdrick, and I can't get up...)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: The most troublesome human of all has arrived.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Baral. I'm your opponent.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Weiss is the same. Champions learn so much useless information. Divine power... No wonder everyone wants to become one.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Baral, you meant to kill me and make Klaus a Champion, didn't you? Or were you using Klaus as bait to kill me?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: That's right. Spending time with the old man has made you fairly perceptive.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Klaus...

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Asmodea's beast ate him, and you, idiot, smashed that beast to pieces. Then the whelp got involved, too. Very entertaining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mayor Klaus...)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I'm not keen on listening to Weiss, but that's enough for now. I'm leaving, fool.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Stop, Baral!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You think I'll stay just because you tell me to stop? What a hopeless fool... A nuisance, but I'll give you one special piece of information.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Stay here, and you'll all get sucked into a rift in spacetime. Now I'm really leaving. If you want to see me again, meet me in Avalon.
(The moment Baral turns his back, his figure disappears like an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That man, Baral... He feels like Weiss. And he said to meet him in Avalon. What is that black hole...?)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: This isn't the time to admire it, little sibling. That black hole wasn't made by a demon. It's a tear in spacetime. It's growing, so we need to leave now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Little sibling, that red rose ornament in your hand. You're giving it to the little demon who follows Peonia around, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Veled asked me to bring it.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Then let's go! Hold tight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hold tight? What do you...?
(Valdrick lifts the adventurer with one hand and sets them on his shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Valdrick grins, then charges madly toward the black hole ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaah! Vaaaaaldrick!
(Peonia looks sadly at Veled, who stands frozen.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled...?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Why aren't you saying anything? Why are you standing like that?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: The demons lingering outside Mars City disappeared, so I came to see if something had happened to you...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Veled...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'm sorry I let this happen... It's my fault. I should have paid closer attention...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Arrived!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. I barely survived.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Uncle Valdrick? %s? Why are you here...?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Peonia, it's been a while. My little sibling had something to deliver to Veled.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Little sibling?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: When you've faced life and death together, you're practically family.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: What on earth happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's complicated...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Tell me, %s. If you're with Uncle Valdrick, it must be something serious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer briefly tells Peonia what happened in Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: So that's why the mayor disappeared. I thought something was going on, but when I found this on his desk and heard your story, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. The Deimos cult's magic stones...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: On behalf of everyone in Mars City, thank you. And thank you too, Uncle Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: I'll handle the aftermath of the mayor's actions properly. Convincing the residents may be difficult... But I'll make sure they understand you weren't responsible, Uncle Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: And...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled will be all right.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's the one who saved me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here, Veled. I brought the red rose pendant, as promised.
(The pendant rises from %s's fingertips and floats toward Veled. The moment it touches his chest, something restraining him shatters.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: He is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Quiet for now, Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Right. Understood.
(Veled's eyes begin to move, as though frozen time has resumed.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Is it over?

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Are you really all right? Can you see me?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes, I'm all right. And thank you. I heard everything...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: N-never mind that. So you're really all right?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. I'm fine. Am I no longer a demon? Was I never one to begin with? But still, a demon...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: Demon or not, you're...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: It's complicated...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: You're really all right, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. And...
(Veled looks toward the adventurer and Valdrick.)

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: All right. You must have something to tell them. Then I'll...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll wait. I always have...

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: All right... I'll go back to Mars, then.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: %s, thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're welcome.

lines.speaker: 피오니아
lines.text: And Uncle Valdrick. I'll make you something delicious, so you have to come. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Sorry? Forget it. You didn't do anything... Hahaha. Get back safely.
(Valdrick waves until Peonia is gone. Once she is well out of sight, Veled approaches quietly.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: You two. There's somewhere I need you to come with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It isn't dangerous, is it?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I just have something to show you. You too, Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I doubt I need to see it, but I'll come along.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Good.
(The moment Veled takes Valdrick and %s by the hand, the scenery changes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...
(Asmodea's voice comes from the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: A doll made from magic stones in my image. With this, I should be able to make myself whole.
(A being resembling Veled stands before Asmodea.)

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You will become me, so I shall name you myself. Veled. Yes, Veled will suit you. The name of the great one who founded Rosengarten.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I dislike it, but if I am to stand against those who covet Rosengarten, I have no choice.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I never knew demons had souls. Nor that those souls could be incomplete.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Trembling with fear that other demons might discover it... How amusing.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Opening a rift in spacetime to enter Rosengarten... I commend you.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Do as you please.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I am curious. You possess power rivaling the leader of the Agasuras, as well as power left by the ancient gods. How did that happen?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Things simply... turned out that way. Perhaps I have even surpassed those pursuing me...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: What an interesting man. In any case, I need only conquer the Demon Realm and answer your summons?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: You, seeking to bring Deimos into this world, and I, holding a part of his brother Phobos. This meeting cannot be coincidence.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: It is what he desires. And what I desire as well.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Let us say our aims differ, but share enough in common.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: One last word. I hope your doll made from magic stones does not awaken somewhere else.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The souls of this land's living beings hold great power. You made something else from stones formed with that power, and mixed another power into it...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Something beyond your expectations could happen.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: That makes me curious. But Veled will never awaken anywhere outside this place.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Good luck.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Has he gone? A human speaking like a demon. How interesting.

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: Now I shall wait for my doll to awaken. And...

lines.speaker: 아스모데아
lines.text: I will never send him anywhere else.
(Asmodea and Rosengarten are no longer visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled, that was...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Some of my memories belonged to Asmodea. That's why Asmodea himself never appeared in them.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Now I'm neither a doll nor a demon. But I'm not human, either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'm all right for now, but I don't think I will be after a while.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I fell here through a black hole. Peonia was the first human I saw, and now I want to understand how I came to love her...

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I want to stand before Peonia properly. Maybe there's a way!
(Veled smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I don't quite understand, but you're a fine fellow. I'd like to call you my little sibling.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: I'll pass.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll put in a good word with Peonia. You've seen it, right? She listens to me pretty well.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Tempting, but I still don't want to call you big brother.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'm only saying I'll call you that.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Then fine.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Good, little sibling Veled. There's nothing quite like gaining a special younger sibling. Right, little sibling %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It doesn't hurt anymore, does it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, now that you mention it...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: It's nothing much, but I shared some of my power and put it into you. That should help the girl who became a new god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Th-thank you, Valdrick! I-Iris will be delighted!

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Goddess... I should call her that, shouldn't I? Once she regains more power, I trust she'll help us beat that bastard Weiss.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Until then, I'll keep getting stronger. I still haven't had my revenge on him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Well, thanks to him, I've got something to live for... Oh, I'll rest a little, then go looking for Baral.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Tell little sibling Ziskad when you return. Say I told you to, and he won't argue.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: I'll be staying in my master's village for a while. Come find me if you want to spar. I'm not what I used to be, but I can manage three days and nights!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, I'll pass.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Veled. Valdrick. I'll be going now. I should tell the person who sent me here that everything worked out.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Lady Gaia... What form is she taking this time? I met her once in Gerda two hundred years ago. I was surprised because she looked like my master.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: But isn't it time for her to sleep again? Or not? Well, I'm sure she's fine. Give her my regards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Take care, Veled.

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Yes. %s, tell old Atkina I said thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I stop by Minuet before going to Dragon Valley? Maybe I can see Lady Gaia again...)
(Veled smiles brightly and waves until %s disappears from Phobos.)

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: Hey, Valdrick.

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: What is it, little sibling?

lines.speaker: 벨레드
lines.text: What will you tell Peonia about me?

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 발드릭
lines.text: That you're a fine fellow who protects Phobos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?
(No matter how often the adventurer calls, Minuet gives no answer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?! Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could something have happened to Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll ask Lord Atkina... Surely nothing's wrong?)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Welcome, %s. I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know what concerns you. The time came, and Lady Gaia went elsewhere.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Realizing that little time remained before her sleep, she headed for the Sanctum of the Covenant.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Sanctum of the Covenant...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A sacred place where those who receive divine revelations swear an oath to a god... I don't know where it is, but it will appear before you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mm-hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow, I feel I'll get there soon...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, then what will happen to Minuet?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Minuet is fine. She's simply asleep, as usual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. I thought something had happened.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I can see why you would. Hahaha.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, thank you for helping Veled. I only thought he would help you. Nothing else occurred to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that just happened along the way...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perhaps I learned more because Valdrick was with you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Now I will be setting out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I will travel beyond Adrica and trace Weiss's movements across the continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina, what about the spirit beasts and Adrica?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Medea has agreed to watch over them for a while. Shynic said she would buy plenty of food in Lumen and feed the beasts enough to keep them alive.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The land has been purified enough to admit those it judges righteous. Ziskad and Miss Io have also promised help if anything happens, so it should be fine for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone except Valdrick, then.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Valdrick is rather special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I know what worries you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: But now that I know Weiss is preparing to bring Deimos into this world, I must stand and fight, as I did before.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: This ancient Pluton Dragon's life was saved by Lady Seres and Lady Gaia. Now it is time to repay them.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It's all right. I have Lady Gaia's permission. Though leaving might seem disrespectful to the one who commanded me to protect this land...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: We cannot let you bear the fate of this world alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Atkina...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Rest here today before you leave. I've prepared much for you. The spirit beasts will be delighted, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll gladly stay and rest. I was just getting hungry...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, a party! A party! Food!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Mir, why are you coming out of there?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ahaha... It's time for me to get moving.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If Mir has come... then perhaps...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Ahaha. Ahaha... Ah... Well...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I was wondering how far I'd have to go to find the adventurer. It's a relief you happened to be here.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I have something for you.
(Mir takes a letter from inside his clothes and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A decree from Her Majesty, the Empress of Silvaria...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Please open it in front of Lord Atkina at the exact time written here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is like last time... A situation that was already foreseen...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Lord Atkina, may I stay with you until then?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I don't mind whenever it is. Stay as long as you like. Today, put everything out of your mind and enjoy yourself. Lady Gaia would want that too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then may I take a short walk through Dragon Valley? I have something to think about...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Of course. By the time you return, we'll have food ready that humans and spirit beasts alike will enjoy.
(While the adventurer steps away, Mir looks quietly at Atkina.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Lord Atkina, the adventurer...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, the adventurer will be all right. Must be all right.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: If anyone brings the adventurer sorrow, the mistress of the earth, moon, flowers, and growing things will not stand idle. Nor will I.
